description: This file defines classes extending Odoo models for Swiss-specific bank information and partner bank details, including fields for bank identifiers, account info, and printing options.

classes.name: Bank
classes.description: Extends res.bank to add Swiss-specific fields like clearing number and city.

classes.name: ResPartnerBank
classes.description: Overrides res.partner.bank to include additional bank account details and printing options, with custom name_get method and SQL constraints.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Overrides the default name_get method to include partner link and bank type name in display.
